{"title":"App crashes when pasting image into comment","body":"## Description
The application crashes when users paste an image into a comment field.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open a comment field (compose new comment or reply to existing)
2. Paste an image from clipboard (e.g., via Ctrl+V or Cmd+V)
3. Observe app crash

## Expected Behavior
- Image should be inserted into the comment field
- User should be able to attach/embed the image with the comment
- App should remain stable and functional

## Actual Behavior
- App crashes immediately or shortly after pasting
- No error message displayed to user
- Comment is lost

## Additional Context
- Affects image pasting specifically (text pasting works normally)
- Occurs across comment threads and reply contexts
- Desktop and web environments affected (if applicable)

## Priority

structured_output.body:
## Description
The application crashes when users paste an image into a comment field.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open a comment field (compose new comment or reply to existing)
2. Paste an image from clipboard (e.g., via Ctrl+V or Cmd+V)
3. Observe app crash

## Expected Behavior
- Image should be inserted into the comment field
- User should be able to attach/embed the image with the comment
- App should remain stable and functional

## Actual Behavior
- App crashes immediately or shortly after pasting
- No error message displayed to user
- Comment is lost

## Additional Context
- Affects image pasting specifically (text pasting works normally)
- Occurs across comment threads and reply contexts
- Desktop and web environments affected (if applicable)

## Priority
High - Core functionality affects user workflow
